view.scene_description: A brightly lit convenience store aisle with refrigerated and open shelves stocked with beverages, snacks, and packaged goods. Decorative hot air balloon ornaments hang from the ceiling. Red signage with Chinese characters is visible above the refrigerators. The floor reflects overhead lighting, creating a clean, commercial atmosphere.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: Long glass-fronted refrigerators line the left side of the aisle, filled with bottled drinks and dairy products. They are mounted to the wall and have white frames. Their reflective surfaces show the store's interior lighting.

objects.label: shelf with packaged goods
objects.observation: White metal shelves on the right hold bags of chips, bread, and other snacks. Items are arranged neatly in rows. The shelves are supported by a gray metal frame and appear freestanding within the store layout.

objects.label: hot air balloon decoration
objects.observation: Several decorative hot air balloons hang from the ceiling. One blue-and-white striped balloon is near the center, another beige-striped balloon is on the right. They are suspended by thin wires and appear to float above the aisles.

objects.label: red sign with Chinese characters
objects.observation: A large red sign with white Chinese characters runs along the top of the refrigerated section. It curves slightly and is mounted directly to the ceiling or wall above the refrigerators. The text reads '就要可口可乐' (Just Coca-Cola).

objects.label: bottled beverages
objects.observation: Rows of bottled beverages, including sodas and juices, are displayed on the lower shelves of the refrigerated unit. Bottles vary in color and shape, with labels facing outward. They are contained within clear plastic bins or directly on shelf edges.

objects.label: overhead fluorescent lights
objects.observation: Long rectangular fluorescent light fixtures are mounted to the black ceiling, providing bright illumination. They run parallel to the aisle and cast reflections on the shiny floor below.

<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000001", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
